text.en:
Section fourteen hundred and ninety-three of the Administrative Code is hereby amended to read
"Section 1493. Specific tax on matches.-On matches there shall be collected:
"(a) On each gross of boxes containing not more than eighty sticks to the box, forty centavos.
"(b) On each gross of boxes containing over eighty sticks to the box, a proportionate additional tax."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Effective, March 11, 1918.
